structure.note: One class of equity shares (fully paid-up shares of ₹10 each; the remaining partly paid rights shares were forfeited during the year). The Promoter and Promoter Group (47 holders) held 49.11% of all shares at March 31, 2025, just under half. Mukesh Ambani personally held 0.12%; most of the group's stake sits in promoter-group LLPs (Srichakra Commercials LLP 10.93%; Devarshi Commercials LLP, Karuna Commercials LLP and Tattvam Enterprises LLP 8.06% each), for which the March 2025 shareholding pattern names Mukesh, Nita, Isha, Akash and Anant Ambani 'together and collectively' as significant beneficial owners. Those LLPs are part of the 49.11% and are not listed separately. Life Insurance Corporation of India (6.61%) is the only non-promoter holder above 5%.

notes: Fiscal year 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 (data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). All figures come from the RIL Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 (consolidated statements, amounts in ₹ crore; 1 crore = 10 million, so crore / 100 = billions). The PDF is hosted on rilstaticasset.akamaized.net, the asset CDN that www.ril.com/investors/financial-reporting links to for all its reports, so it is treated as the company's own host. PDF page numbers refer to that file (two printed pages per PDF page). OWNERSHIP: as at March 31, 2025. The 49.11% promoter-group figure and LIC's 6.61% are percentages of all 1353,23,72,898 shares, including the 1.99% held by the custodian against GDRs. RIL's Reg 31 shareholding pattern for the same date (https://rilstaticasset.akamaized.net/sites/default/files/2025-04/SHP31032025.pdf, also read) shows 50.11% and 6.74% because SEBI's format divides by shares excluding those underlying depository receipts; its % of total voting rights column gives 49.11% for the promoter group, so the group does not hold a majority of votes. Mukesh Ambani's 0.12% (1,61,04,040 shares after the 1:1 bonus issue of October 2024) is his own registered holding as listed in Note 14.3; the family total includes it, so the two must not be added. No individual figure for his indirect interest through the promoter LLPs is disclosed. Other large institutional holders below 5% are not named in the annual report, so only LIC is listed. DIVIDENDS: ₹6,766 crore paid to equity holders of the company (excludes ₹414 crore paid to non-controlling interests). BUYBACKS: the consolidated cash-flow statement has no share-repurchase line for 2024-25, so 0. STOCK COMP: null. The consolidated statements give no share-based payment expense figure; the only number is the ₹10 crore increase in the Share Based Payments Reserve ('On Employee Stock Options', Note 15), a reserve movement rather than a stated expense, so it is not used. GEOGRAPHY: the secondary segment split is of 'Value of Sales and Services' (₹10,71,174 crore), which is before deducting GST recovered (₹91,038 crore); Revenue from Operations is ₹9,80,136 crore.
